stage0078_03:r_3bc300bbdc277d82.text:
$$ミサト$$
「To be precise, it was only an attempt.
　The culprit's been apprehended」

stage0078_03:r_38762a09460d8b6b.text:
$$甲児$$
「I knew it, the culprit is...」

stage0078_03:r_7ab28e70b4d4f641.text:
$$ミサト$$
「Just as everyone guessed, someone
　from Neo Zeon」

stage0078_03:r_b05f6a6e8f3d9b24.text:
$$アルト$$
「I can't believe it...
　$$シャア・アズナブル$$, doing something like that」

stage0078_03:r_ec335e69f984b8b3.text:
$$ミシェル$$
「I feel the same way.
　Then it must be $$ハマーン・カーン$$ or
　$$フル・フロンタル$$ pulling the strings」

stage0078_03:r_0abcaf0c31978670.text:
$$田中司令$$
「Their side thinks the same, it seems.
　But that's not the only surprise, either」

stage0078_03:r_1d6bc48b7f246730.text:
$$ミサト$$
「Neo Zeon broke the ceasefire and sent
　in their forces, and during that fight...」

stage0078_03:r_1af20fccc3c53cfc.text:
$$ミサト$$
「We found out $$オードリー$$ is $$ミネバ$$ Zabi」

stage0078_03:r_4d863c3fb88a4c39.text:
$$葵$$
「$$ミネバ$$ Zabi... The last survivor of
　the Zabi family...!?」

stage0078_03:r_44f4742c3dcce39a.text:
$$くらら$$
「Why would she, an enemy, be with the
　Federation's $c...!?」

stage0078_03:r_9e701cdeb3842c21.text:
$$ミサト$$
「I don't know the details, but it doesn't
　seem like she was a spy or anything」

stage0078_03:r_6fd81f4abebe60c5.text:
$$朔哉$$
「Yeah...
　She looked happy with $$バナージ$$ and the others」

stage0078_03:r_da2132b5038ec737.text:
$$ジョニー$$
「I was a bit concerned, since she'd
　sometimes get this distant look, or
　seem lost in thought...」

stage0078_03:r_495d61d3ec7e16f2.text:
$$ミサト$$
「In that battle, $$ギュネイ$$, $$クェス$$ and
　$$マリーダ$$ withdrew, and $$ミネバ$$ Zabi left
　together with Ensign $$リディ$$」

stage0078_03:r_5cd353758cfe474d.text:
$$甲児$$
「So why was Ensign $$リディ$$ there?」

stage0078_03:r_a653c8dec4c0f06f.text:
$$エイーダ$$
「Don't tell me it's a lovers' escape?」

stage0078_03:r_86d493e37a9799a7.text:
$$ミサト$$
「...Some of you might already know, but
　Ensign $$リディ$$ is the son of a powerful
　Earth Federation politician」

stage0078_03:r_09d0fcc600cdd3df.text:
$$ジョニー$$
「Assemblyman $$ローナン・マーセナス$$, right?」

stage0078_03:r_182faded068c15ed.text:
$$ミサト$$
「Ensign $$リディ$$ tried to get $$ミネバ$$ Zabi
　to meet his father, to stop the war
　between the Federation and the colonies」

stage0078_03:r_9c206d19bfda4bd5.text:
$$ミサト$$
「And apparently, that was $$ミネバ$$ Zabi's
　own wish too」

stage0078_03:r_6e558bc69acf5bf3.text:
$n
「What does $$バナージ$$ have to say about that?」

stage0078_03:r_d60d0818e965232f.text:
$$田中司令$$
「Well, that's... unfortunately, $$バナージ$$
　has been captured by Neo Zeon」

stage0078_03:r_43e4e548c0b28376.text:
$$ミサト$$
「My bad, hang on...
　I'll go take this call」

stage0078_03:r_d80a9688790ed583.text:
$n
「So, Mr. Tanaka...
　what happened to $$バナージ$$?」

stage0078_03:r_708bea61e3c43ada.text:
$$田中司令$$
「Unfortunately, we can't track Neo Zeon's
　movements, but we know where they'll
　show up next」

stage0078_03:r_7b6f159eeaf4de0f.text:
$n
「The coordinates Unicorn's Laplace
　Program pointed to... Dakar, huh」

stage0078_03:r_0827963cfd706e8d.text:
$$田中司令$$
「That's right.
　The detached unit is repairing their
　machines and preparing to head to Dakar」

stage0078_03:r_ff6f8bdca2dd2bc9.text:
$$甲児$$
「If Neo Zeon's on the move, shouldn't
　we head to Dakar too?」

stage0078_03:r_3f4035fd9db81258.text:
$$アルト$$
「I agree with that.
　Given the broken truce and Captain
　$$アムロ$$'s assassination, they'll stop at nothing」

stage0078_03:r_567b361a454c4b73.text:
$$ミサト$$
「This isn't the time for that.
　I need all of you to head to $$第３新東京市$$
　right away」

stage0078_03:r_352534f64413d954.text:
$$ミサト$$
「That's right.
　An Angel's approach has been confirmed」

stage0078_03:r_7a7add80fde475ba.text:
$$マコト$$
「...Detected 3 minutes ago at the Mauna
　Kea Observatory. Inputting orbital
　elements」

stage0078_03:r_b2befefdbed1393d.text:
$$シゲル$$
「The Third Watch Satellite has it in
　optical range. Bringing up max zoom」

stage0078_03:r_a12e3e130d896ff7.text:
$$ミサト$$
「I never imagined it would come at us
　from space, of all things...」

stage0078_03:r_b6f7b219eb4bd64b.text:
$$ミサト$$
「An A.T. Field strong enough to bend light...
　impressive. So the predicted impact point
　is here, naturally, right?」

stage0078_03:r_91bf33c27ad39f0a.text:
$$マヤ$$
「MAGI's recalculated. The probability
　of impact on NERV HQ is 99.9999%」

stage0078_03:r_ee220318b96ab538.text:
$$ミサト$$
「Just hearing that number is exhausting」

stage0078_03:r_ce1b55e526b6277a.text:
$$マコト$$
「In response, Neo Zeon's forces launched
　an attack, but...」

stage0078_03:r_c304df6888eb78f7.text:
$$ミサト$$
「No need to ask how that went.
　Standard-issue mobile suits can't
　handle an Angel」

stage0078_03:r_c26958634526e597.text:
$$リツコ$$
「Commander Ikari and Vice Commander
　$$冬月$$ are away. And $c's forces are
　at half strength... Just what we needed」

stage0078_03:r_cdb750c9d380881a.text:
$$ミサト$$
「Those two... haven't they been on a lot
　of business trips lately?」

stage0078_03:r_95fda74613c97b39.text:
$$リツコ$$
「It's a month and a half until
　$$エタニティ・フラット$$. They're probably
　busy with all sorts of things」

stage0078_03:r_1956994937f8171e.text:
$$ミサト$$
「...So, can we correct that Angel's
　trajectory?」

stage0078_03:r_48f49f6728c15612.text:
$$リツコ$$
「I ran the numbers again and again.
　It's impossible」

stage0078_03:r_0ebc5a6f1e0f81bf.text:
$$マヤ$$
「It's focusing its A.T. Field into a
　single point and pushing forward.
　Add the fall's kinetic energy on top」

stage0078_03:r_f02c37d91387d0ad.text:
$$リツコ$$
「A little shock won't even faze it」

stage0078_03:r_6bbd5a3c5afb87e0.text:
$$ミサト$$
「So the Angel itself is basically the bomb」

stage0078_03:r_9796b3efa401a303.text:
$$マヤ$$
「Estimated blast on direct impact by
　the Eighth Angel: 420,000 in diameter.
　Geoid level minus 15,000」

stage0078_03:r_643b6eebfc0186b3.text:
$$マコト$$
「$$第３新東京市$$ would be vaporized.
　Not just the Geofront, even Central
　Dogma would be stripped bare」

stage0078_03:r_291280e5f7eb9d70.text:
$$シゲル$$
「$$第３新東京市$$'s citizens have already
　begun evacuating」

stage0078_03:r_32eb462c1b4999cb.text:
$$ミサト$$
「No matter where they flee, it won't
　matter if this place gets hit...」

stage0078_03:r_1f4337d6d393fc37.text:
$$リツコ$$
「So what's the plan? Intercept it
　outside the atmosphere with the
　super robot team?」

stage0078_03:r_4740e748fae085ee.text:
$$ミサト$$
「Unfortunately, damage from the last
　battle still hasn't been repaired.
　High-altitude combat's out too」

stage0078_03:r_b76524cd840e1d37.text:
$$シゲル$$
「The spatial distortion is so severe
　that sniping from any point is
　impossible too」

stage0078_03:r_730ffe18400abfc2.text:
$$マコト$$
「Against an outrageous opponent like
　this, there's nothing we can do」

stage0078_03:r_ffe0fca26da5cd38.text:
$$ミサト$$
「We can't get close...
　Attacking from a distance won't work...
　So there's only one way left」

stage0078_03:r_8eaf6f3098ffed12.text:
$$アスカ$$
「Whaaat!?
　Catch it with our hands!?」

stage0078_03:r_cf507214fe955d75.text:
$$ミサト$$
「That's right.
　We'll catch the incoming Angel head-on
　with the EVA's A.T. Field at full power」

stage0078_03:r_2113dcbabdfc758a.text:
$$ミサト$$
「Only an EVA, with an A.T. Field like
　the Angel's own, can pull this off」

stage0078_03:r_4b0e43ba6a5f2f5b.text:
$$シンジ$$
「Only an EVA... only we can do it...」

stage0078_03:r_5b992878fee054b5.text:
$$ミサト$$
「The target's scrambling its position
　data, so we can't get an accurate
　trajectory from compensated observation」

stage0078_03:r_95a3dd16c2c4cc3e.text:
$$ミサト$$
「To respond from multiple angles as
　needed, this operation will deploy
　all three EVAs at once」

stage0078_03:r_4a14ec0c511c7f0d.text:
$$アスカ$$
「Waste of time. I can wipe it out
　all by myself!」

stage0078_03:r_20cf167c0ec0d4d5.text:
$$ミサト$$
「No good. A single EVA can't cover
　the huge predicted impact area」

stage0078_03:r_b591d812c96c6c99.text:
$$レイ#333$$
「What's the basis for the three-unit
　deployment?」

stage0078_03:r_bccc48e1964ad22d.text:
$$アスカ$$
「The other EVAs are just in the way.
　I'm plenty for an operation like this!」

stage0078_03:r_f8736aaaa216c766.text:
$$ミサト$$
「What this op needs isn't a good
　track record in single combat」

stage0078_03:r_d1ec2522c87c361d.text:
$$アスカ$$
「So you won't acknowledge my talent」

stage0078_03:r_3599f0a4343fd95c.text:
$$ミサト$$
「That's not it.
　I need the strength of all three of you」

stage0078_03:r_94a88c90e557e16e.text:
$$ミサト$$
「There's still time before the Angel
　reaches the surface, but we don't know
　what might happen. Get into position early」

stage0078_03:r_5b7ee307a700171a.text:
$$アスカ$$
「Listen up, Teacher's Pet, Daddy's Boy?
　If you slow me down, I'll never
　forgive you」

stage0078_03:r_adec86483b13599a.text:
$$リツコ$$
「You call this plan an operation?
　Even MAGI puts failure above 99%...
　Technical Division can't accept this」

stage0078_03:r_c17c58fdba72005e.text:
$$リツコ$$
「Steady effort beats waiting for a miracle.
　Protecting $$リリス$$ and Unit-01 should
　be top priority」

stage0078_03:r_f527e012803f7f1c.text:
$$リツコ$$
「The girl who got thrown here by a
　dimensional tremor...?」

stage0078_03:r_4b1247bd3ca4905d.text:
$$ミサト$$
「'Miracles happen. I'll make one happen'...
　she said」

stage0078_03:r_338f3b27e51dcc41.text:
$$ミサト$$
「I'm not going to wait.
　We'll make the miracle happen,
　through human will」

stage0078_03:r_0c8ea89b07432421.text:
$$ミサト$$
「I'm the one in charge right now.
　I'll make the call. Besides, destroying
　Angels is my job」

stage0078_03:r_4dbfba00ba7744ee.text:
$$リツコ$$
「Your job? It's a personal grudge,
　isn't it? Your revenge against the
　Angels is...!」

stage0078_03:r_3dad695c99e9e052.text:
$$リツコ$$
「Even with time, there's nothing we
　can prepare」

stage0078_03:r_0c18da7b3a37825d.text:
$$リツコ$$
「Do you have some kind of plan?」

stage0078_03:r_b025267f22788233.text:
$$凱$$
「That's exactly it!
　You're not man enough, that's why $$アスカ$$
　goes that far on you!」

stage0078_03:r_ec1a06a7023bf72c.text:
$$シンジ$$
「But it's true that Shikinami's strong...」

stage0078_03:r_8805f96e52aaa462.text:
$$凱$$
「Argh, this is so frustrating!
　Say something too, boss!」

stage0078_03:r_124591cb154fae64.text:
$$弁慶$$
「$$凱$$'s got a point, $$シンジ$$.
　In the end, women want a man to be a man.」

stage0078_03:r_7bdb6fecc8b3bde8.text:
$$弁慶$$
「Good chance.
　Show her what a man you are.」

stage0078_03:r_eaa52d152f444bfd.text:
$$ミシェル$$
「That 'be a man' talk from $$凱$$ and $$弁慶$$
　is so old-fashioned.」

stage0078_03:r_a9227573166977a9.text:
$$ミシェル$$
「Listen, $$シンジ$$.
　Going on about being a man like that
　is just stifling.」

stage0078_03:r_b0600ab9a9e8559d.text:
$$青山$$
「$$ミシェル$$'s right.
　If you want to win $$アスカ$$ over, you should
　think of a different approach.」

stage0078_03:r_7cbc63dad295f862.text:
$$シンジ$$
「Isn't this turning into a different
　conversation...!?」

stage0078_03:r_07f53c816e0a51f5.text:
$$ルカ$$
「That's right, $$青山$$.
　$$シンジ$$'s actually interested in $$レイ#333$$.」

stage0078_03:r_0476ffd10c764b0e.text:
$$ミシェル$$
「It's the talk of $c right now,
　whether you're into $$アスカ$$ or $$レイ#333$$.」

stage0078_03:r_48c6c1ecfea6fe4a.text:
$$ミレーヌ$$
「Way to go, $$シンジ$$!
　Why not apprentice under $$アルト$$,
　the love-triangle master?」

stage0078_03:r_2b3479c4cf0680f4.text:
$$ガムリン$$
（Ms. $$ミレーヌ$$...
　conveniently forgetting about herself again...）

stage0078_03:r_e370696b8936b08c.text:
$$シンジ$$
「Uh... um... even if you say that now...」

stage0078_03:r_9d7b02c5e728b7aa.text:
$$赤木$$
「My bad, my bad.
　Guess it's a big moment before the op.」

stage0078_03:r_9af213fc64e0afec.text:
$$赤木$$
「Basically, $$シンジ$$...
　there's just one thing we want to say.」

stage0078_03:r_9eb8599304125b2f.text:
$$ガムリン$$
「Just do your best, $$シンジ$$.」

stage0078_03:r_a072aa25e5f521e0.text:
$$赤木$$
「We're rooting for you with everything
　we've got, $$シンジ$$.」

stage0078_03:r_817b2773b4ed563e.text:
$$アスカ$$
「What, why's everyone trooping over here...」

stage0078_03:r_1cc233cbc8c80af7.text:
$$谷川$$
「Ugh! You're no fun!
　And here we came to cheer you up!」

stage0078_03:r_3ce2f3e58cfdc3ba.text:
$$アスカ$$
「Too bad.
　Maybe for Daddy's Boy, but I don't
　need anything like that.」

stage0078_03:r_e180b22d18f48d38.text:
$$いぶき$$
「Don't be so prickly. We're here, so
　let's talk until the operation starts.」

stage0078_03:r_e598c2a0b27e7f50.text:
$$ヨーコ$$
「This is what they call girl talk, huh.」

stage0078_03:r_8fe40600ce62dfbc.text:
$$アスカ$$
「I hate it when grown-ups get that
　smug preachy look on their face!」

stage0078_03:r_ff4ce5f3cf96b617.text:
$$中原$$
「That's not it...!
　I just thought your skin looks nice...」

stage0078_03:r_c2df6b71e3b4b6ec.text:
$$入江$$
「...Could that be a double score, by any chance?」

stage0078_03:r_e3d111e8bb190cb1.text:
$$アスカ$$
「Huh... so you do care about your age?」

stage0078_03:r_7c0d3c51f9a11ca0.text:
$$大山$$
「That's right.
　So that kind of talk is off-limits
　for $$ミサト$$ and $$スメラギ$$ too, you know.」

stage0078_03:r_ab97c2b2418ea732.text:
$$大山$$
「Unless you really want to make
　an adult mad, that is.」

stage0078_03:r_050d0532c4b24bfe.text:
$$ヨーコ$$
「Looks like even $$アスカ$$ couldn't stand up
　to $$大山$$'s sheer presence.」

stage0078_03:r_475f7653621a91b5.text:
$$大山$$
「But really, your skin... is lovely.」

stage0078_03:r_f228ae702350849b.text:
$$谷川$$
「Don't tell me you've never even worn makeup?」

stage0078_03:r_d69dc027cba3003f.text:
$$アスカ$$
「I don't need anything like that...」

stage0078_03:r_3c3735172a480b72.text:
$$谷川$$
「What's a girl your age doing without it!」

stage0078_03:r_1f418b5594cea300.text:
$$中原$$
「Ending up like $$谷川$$ would be a problem,
　but maybe a little lip color wouldn't hurt.」

stage0078_03:r_f87fb889124bfaef.text:
$$ヨーコ$$
「Isn't there someone you'd want to look nice for?」

stage0078_03:r_33f7fd55913419e8.text:
$$郁絵$$
「Sorry for the wait.
　The muffins are ready.」

stage0078_03:r_4de6ac85c63bac12.text:
$$いぶき$$
「Come on, $$アスカ$$, let's eat too.」

stage0078_03:r_6d77e72dbbcd7dfe.text:
$$アスカ$$
「This kind of thing... might be nice...」

stage0078_03:r_0cea115be526a319.text:
$$アスカ$$
「It's nothing but trash pickup, every day!
　And after, it's fried chicken, burgers,
　beef bowls, ramen, nothing but grease!」

stage0078_03:r_d36072babd12aeb4.text:
$$アスカ$$
「Not elegant, not even a little!
　Not lovely! Not fashionable, either!」

stage0078_03:r_62ecd978c667bd29.text:
$$アスカ$$
「W-what!
　I only go because $$カレン$$ and $$かなめ$$
　get on my case if I skip!」

stage0078_03:r_d441e6cc908ac01b.text:
$$大山$$
「I'll hear the rest after the operation's over.」

stage0078_03:r_653b741d07545dff.text:
$$ヨーコ$$
「We're counting on you, $$アスカ$$.」

stage0078_03:r_d584d4b5af55b1cf.text:
$$アスカ$$
「Who do you think I am?」

stage0078_03:r_db0ee69ece206fcd.text:
$$ヨーコ$$
「OK.
　Once you say that, I've got no choice
　but to trust you.」

stage0078_03:r_7980fd37141d88d0.text:
$$アルト$$
（Can't believe we got stuck babysitting
　$$レイ#333$$...）

stage0078_03:r_ac21212c36d2b9ad.text:
$n
（$$ミサト$$ and Miss $$スズネ$$ picked us for this.
　Don't complain.）

stage0078_03:r_a26e2108358af7a4.text:
$$アルト$$
（Still, there's no getting through
　that silence of hers...）

stage0078_03:r_017a56991b7b8ca4.text:
$n
（Right.
　Time to show some dignity as president.）

stage0078_03:r_ad3e1db3419665fb.text:
$$アルト$$
（You're dumping all the annoying stuff
　on me!?）

stage0078_03:r_0149e3a5f2e5ef78.text:
$n
（You... think cheering up $$レイ#333$$
　is a hassle?）

stage0078_03:r_bdc546b199c80996.text:
$n
（I'm disappointed, $$アルト$$.
　Is that really the kind of man you are?）

stage0078_03:r_22c8caf8c08c5119.text:
$n
（If Chidori and $$カレン$$ heard about this,
　they'd be furious...）

stage0078_03:r_9c13714b3efbc7a8.text:
$$アルト$$
（Fine!
　I'll do it, I'll do it already!）

stage0078_03:r_feb0390bba7fe1fb.text:
$$アルト$$
（What are you talking about!
　What I do is command, like a president should!）

stage0078_03:r_f42017dfce31dea9.text:
$$アルト$$
（First up, $n!
　You're used to dealing with broody
　types, so you go! President's orders!）

stage0078_03:r_fd6bdf7910d7d925.text:
$n
「N-nice weather, isn't it?
　Hard to believe Angels will fall from it.」

stage0078_03:r_fa59c6df081e6ae4.text:
$$アルト$$
（Alright... that lowers the bar for me.
　Let's go, $$甲児$$!）

stage0078_03:r_ca3edf3b8b52aedf.text:
$$甲児$$
（$n...!
　Your sacrifice won't be in vain!）

stage0078_03:r_0b3b19cddb871f90.text:
$$アルト$$
「Anyway, eat this bento.
　$$甲児$$ and I made it ourselves.」

stage0078_03:r_b740d817a14afd3a.text:
$$甲児$$
「There's miso soup too.
　You liked that, right?」

stage0078_03:r_019293cb83599509.text:
$n
（If you had a trump card like that,
　you should've used it from the start!）

stage0078_03:r_9b949b9281aaeef1.text:
$$レイ#333$$
「This... did senior Saotome make it?」

stage0078_03:r_c9016e3ab05470b0.text:
$$レイ#333$$
「Please teach me how to make it」

stage0078_03:r_a5774604a0f00702.text:
$$アルト$$
「N-no...
　I was just a little surprised」

stage0078_03:r_b4fa30f33e84207f.text:
$$甲児$$
「Alright, $$レイ#333$$!
　Once the mission's over, I'll give you the recipe」

stage0078_03:r_9133b7e0b34de48f.text:
$n
「Let's do our best, $$レイ#333$$.
　If we combine our strength with $$シンジ$$
　and $$アスカ$$, I'm sure it'll work out」

stage0078_03:r_ddd97a6ef823929a.text:
$$竜馬$$
「This punk...!
　Acting all humble like he's somebody!」

stage0078_03:r_df349052cd9cdd0c.text:
$$シモン$$
「At times like this, you should just say it.
　'Did you see my true power!'...like that」

stage0078_03:r_a7ce9f908380694c.text:
$$シンジ$$
「D-did you see my true power...」

stage0078_03:r_de3cc1f733dcb073.text:
$$ワッ太$$
「No way, no way, $$シンジ$$!
　'Ore' doesn't suit you one bit!」

stage0078_03:r_c32efc7394910997.text:
$$ミサト$$
「Yeah, yeah... sorry to break the
　victory party mood. There's a call
　for you, $$シンジ$$」

stage0078_03:r_7cf3c91395139f5c.text:
$$ゲンドウ$$
「I heard from Colonel Katsuragi.
　Well done, $$シンジ$$」

stage0078_03:r_5cb2acefa1e7c7fb.text:
$$アスカ$$
「You called me by name just now,
　taking advantage of the chaos, didn't you?」

stage0078_03:r_33f67c683bda9203.text:
$$アスカ$$
「Fine, you can call me $$アスカ$$, just
　this once. I'll call you Stupid $$シンジ$$, too」

stage0078_03:r_6be0d6139fac197c.text:
$$アスカ$$
「Don't go using it already,
　Stupid $$シンジ$$!」

stage0078_03:r_308e8ac66b1141ef.text:
$$ミサト$$
「Seems a miracle happened here too」

stage0078_03:r_9f7c18d1ea1b55c9.text:
$$アルト$$
「The miso soup recipe I promised」

stage0078_03:r_c7ef92060bb8199d.text:
$$シンジ$$
「It's been a while since I came to $$第３新東京市$$,
　so we're all staying at $$ミサト$$'s place tonight.
　Won't you come too, Ayanami?」

stage0078_03:r_1be6d12f616f04e4.text:
$$レイ#333$$
「Is it... really okay for me too?」

stage0078_03:r_80f948aeaed93de8.text:
$$シンジ$$
「Of course.
　I'll even make the miso soup you like
　for dinner, Ayanami」

stage0078_03:r_da648116badd491a.text:
$$アスカ$$
「What is it, Teacher's Pet.
　You're quite the glutton, aren't you...」

stage0078_03:r_4e91ccecf1dd0f66.text:
$$シンジ$$
「Don't say things like that, $$アスカ$$」

stage0078_03:r_668b7114a3ac1d77.text:
$$アスカ$$
「Don't get carried away and keep
　calling me that over and over!」

stage0078_03:r_ef339c6f71e7560f.text:
$$ミサト$$
（Seems like today was a day miracles
　come easy...）

stage0078_03:r_6f4f8dd80820f5e7.text:
$$ゲンドウ$$
「...The Eighth Angel's annihilation
　has been confirmed」

stage0078_03:r_afa513b4815df4c9.text:
$$冬月$$
「Despite some margin of error, right
　on schedule after all, is it...」

stage0078_03:r_6cf1e5ed68d98bd4.text:
$$ゲンドウ$$
「As expected, it's Geminis we should
　be wary of... and Chrono, is it」

stage0078_03:r_e62eb587b8d34cb9.text:
$$ゲンドウ$$
「Old men tend to be conservative types,
　troublesome in every world, in every
　era, it seems」

stage0078_03:r_d72cc2c0739c9088.text:
$$冬月$$
「But there are also those who call
　themselves reformists. Their conflict,
　I think, has meaning」

stage0078_03:r_ecf4e1c8c0f8d2d7.text:
$$ゲンドウ$$
「It's nothing but a farce, in the end.
　We need only advance the schedule
　by our own hands」

stage0078_03:r_e5a692ea5ce09cac.text:
$$冬月$$
「...There's also the matter of the
　Prison of Time. The details will need
　adjusting」

stage0078_03:r_2be6c657d0e12c4b.text:
$$冬月$$
「Then what will you do about the
　pending Unit-03 experiment?」

stage0078_03:r_7569f965fff4d791.text:
$$ゲンドウ$$
「Proceed with EVA Unit-03's activation experiment」
「Freeze EVA Unit-03's activation experiment」

stage0078_03:r_b43bdba9393d4d68.text:
$$ゲンドウ$$
「Adherence to schedule takes top priority.
　Arrange for Unit-03's activation experiment」

stage0078_03:r_3ec159d1a3492877.text:
$$冬月$$
「Understood.
　What do you intend to do about the pilot?」

stage0078_03:r_4e2fbafa9ebef558.text:
$$ゲンドウ$$
「I'll leave that to Colonel Katsuragi」

stage0078_03:r_bde2e27bac7e3317.text:
$$ゲンドウ$$
「It won't significantly affect the schedule.
　Freeze Unit-03's activation experiment」

stage0078_03:r_631834aa1545ba7b.text:
$$冬月$$
「Understood. Depending on the situation,
　Unit-03 might be scrapped, is it...」

stage0078_03:r_0cd6aab432ee5af7.text:
$$ゲンドウ$$
「It doesn't matter.
　There's something more pressing right now」

stage0078_03:r_9293c52555ba1457.text:
$$アスカ$$
「What did you get from $$アルト$$?」

stage0078_03:r_51ce1d8caa34c103.text:
$$レイ#333$$
「Because I don't need to tell you」

stage0078_03:r_2c37dd5b8f919a88.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Now, now... you two,
　there's no need to quarrel right after
　such a hard-won mission success」

stage0078_03:r_53f5199f05a9aad8.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Everyone was quite impressed by how
　the two of you performed, you know」

stage0078_03:r_c6937f14a8985c35.text:
$$アスカ$$
「That chipper attitude of yours...
　I just can't trust it」

stage0078_03:r_07513334490fbdf9.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Even if you don't believe my words,
　the Z-Chip does not lie」

stage0078_03:r_d90c4affdd742a0e.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Everyone got so excited over your
　performance that 100Z worth of Z-Chips
　were born. I'll add these to the squad's stock」

stage0078_03:r_082a55c75a163780.text:
$$アスカ$$
「So everyone's finally acknowledged my
　true skill. Mm-hmm... not a bad trend」

stage0078_03:r_f5507082e5c31362.text:
$$アスカ$$
「What. If you've got something to say,
　say it clearly」

stage0078_03:r_3c9956c9d519d2a2.text:
$$レイ#333$$
「You should just be honest and show
　what's in your heart like that」

stage0078_03:r_d150caab246bbd7a.text:
$$アスカ$$
「N-none of your business!
　Especially from you, Teacher's Pet!」

stage0078_03:r_fc1b13eaa4071b9a.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Thank you for the verbal abuse,
　as always」

stage0078_03:r_c4cdd41ba9207e9c.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
（If possible, I'd rather not lose
　this reward...）

stage0078_03:r_8a9ac301023aa8d3.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
「I heard, Master $$シンジ$$.
　You got permission to call Master $$アスカ$$
　by name, so they say」

stage0078_03:r_4cab8ba7b88b6c2a.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
「This has really closed the distance
　between you two. And once 'Stupid' drops
　from 'Stupid $$シンジ$$', the next stage awaits...」

stage0078_03:r_20aab898d4d14e51.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
「How about it?
　Since it's a good opportunity, why not
　try calling Master $$レイ#333$$ by name too?」

stage0078_03:r_88461d9fd17c56e7.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
「It'd be embarrassing in front of them,
　so why not practice here first?」

stage0078_03:r_d7bf635b7e5f811c.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Come on!
　Master $$凱$$ and Master $$弁慶$$ told you to
　show some manliness, didn't they?」

stage0078_03:r_24cb831c779807fd.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Now then!
　Let's work up the courage and say the name!」

stage0078_03:r_67c9e002d64d9781.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Yes, thank you very much!
　Now then, let's give it our all today too!!」
